text:
anya: Heads up — proposal for a lightweight per-route "Signalboard" in Redwood Console. Goal: one pane where SREs and product owners can eyeball p50/p95/p99 token latency, throughput, 5m error rate, and a few runtime signals (kernel distro, batch-size histogram, KV cache hit%).

kevin: love the name. main ask: we need token-level waterfall so we can spot KV vs kernel stalls. Can we show a stacked bar for mean token time broken into phases? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

elaine: basic widget list from my side: p50/p95/p99 latency (ms), reqs/s, errors/5m, 99th token time, cache_hit_ratio, avg_batch_size, kernel_choice_distribution. Also want small sparkline for recent perf regressions.

rob: for alerts propose: error_rate_5m > 0.5% -> P1, p95_token_latency > 1200ms -> page, p99 > 3000ms -> page + slack. Keep thresholds per-route overrideable.

anya: agreed. UX mock: left column route selector + traffic %, middle: KPIs (big numbers), right: runtime breakdowns (stacked waterfall + histograms). Below: recent traces/representative requests.

kevin: instrumentation notes — prefer we derive token waterfall from existing span tags: token.enter (kv_lookup), token.kernel, token.emit. If missing, fall back to timing buckets. Example PromQL for p95 token latency:

```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
```

For KV hit rate:

```
sum(rate(kv_hits_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(kv_lookups_total[5m])) by (route)
```

elaine: can we also show kernel selection ratio? i.e. % requests that picked quantized kernel vs float? PromQL: 

```
sum(rate(kernel_selected_total{kernel="quantized"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(kernel_selected_total[5m])) by (route)
```

rob: batch-size histogram is critical — we currently emit batch_size as a label on serve_request metrics which skews histogram cardinality. Suggest exporting batch_size as a histogram metric instead. Then compute p50/p95 of batch size.

kevin: notes on sampling: for routes with high QPS, sample 1% of requests with full token timing and send to perf-aggregation to avoid high cardinality. Console can extrapolate.

anya: UI behaviors: default time window 15m, quick toggle 1h/6h/24h. When route uses multiple model variants show an autosplit by model_version. Add a tiny badge for 'KV miss spike' when cache_hit_ratio drops > 10% vs baseline.

rob: alert ideas: (1) rapid drop in throughput + p95 spike = possible capacity regression; (2) KV miss spike + p99 token increase = cache invalidation bug; (3) kernel_change_share > 30% in 5m = rollout might be using different kernels.

elaine: can we embed a small profiler link per-route that opens the last 20 sampled traces and highlights tokens where kernel time dominated? That will speed debugging.

kevin: small example dashboard widget JSON (pseudo):

```
{
  "widget": "stacked_token_waterfall",
  "metrics": ["token.kv_ms","token.kernel_ms","token.emit_ms"],
  "quantile": 0.95,
  "group_by": "route"
}
```

anya: ops question — what's the retention cost? we want raw token spans for sampled requests only 7d, aggregates 90d. OK?

rob: 7d sampled raw is fine. aggregates (histograms) 90d should allow trends. Need to ensure we downsample histograms for long windows.

deploy-bot: dashboard/route-signalboard v0.1 deployed to staging at 2026-03-12T14:22:30Z :white_check_mark:

anya: awesome — can folks try staging for routes: /v2/generation, /chat, /embeddings and drop feedback here? prioritize p95 token waterfall clarity and KV badge usefulness.

kevin: testing now on /v2/generation — saw a kernel_choice bump after the latest runtime change, kernel_change_share ~ 42% in 5m. Putting a canary rollback in progress.

elaine: tested embeddings route — cache_hit_ratio badge fired once for a 10m window, but false positive due to transient backend restart. Suggest making badge require sustained drop > 2m.

rob: noted. I'll update alert to require 2m sustained and add a suppressed_state when deployments in progress.

anya: great. leaving this for next week's planning doc. If nothing else, I'll open a short RFC with screenshots. Thanks team :clap:

deploy-bot: dashboard/route-signalboard v0.1.1 pushed: adjusted kv badge sensitivity.
